d:
DRecords is proud to release this very exclusive Navratri Bhajan 2024 and rare gem of a Live performance by Daler Mehndi titled Aajo Jinne Par Langna from Album Maa – The Navratri Special, on the occasion of Navratri.
The three song album opens with the very soulful Ni Maye Lutte Gaye leading to Aajo Jinhe Paar Langna and finally to the pacy Mainu Sohna Jeha Maa Da Darbar Mileya all written and composed by Daler Mehndi.
